ResearchProjectDef.label: planetary networking
ResearchProjectDef.description: By establishing quantum entanglement channels, colonists can link local Matter Networks to a planetary ledger. Unlocks the Quantum Network Relay, enabling baseline cross-map digital transfers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: quantum bandwidth I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Optimizes quantum telemetry arrays, boosting the speed and efficiency of cross-map digital routing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: quantum bandwidth II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks completely uncapped planetary transfer speeds, allowing instant cross-map synchronization of high-volume digital storage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: quantum bandwidth III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Introduces a sub-atomic compression algorithm, increasing the Quantum Relay bandwidth limit to 10,000 items and reducing transaction interval to 60 ticks (1 second).

ResearchProjectDef.label: quantum instantaneous sync
ResearchProjectDef.description: Achieves hyper-entanglement, allowing the relay to synchronize materials almost instantaneously (every 10 ticks) with unlimited bandwidth capacity.
